name: Myx's Bittersweet Musings
source:
This is the SECOND game in the tetralogy. Contains Myx's past and continues off the true ending of the first game.

Who doesn't want friends? (At least Myx... does?)

As Myx the disabled bird genius and social outcast, you will see life through her eyes and help her make some decisions on how to raise a seemingly sentient and life-like computer.

...

But you already know what happens...?

[From [url=https://mintglow.itch.io/myxs-bittersweet-musings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是四部曲中的第二款游戏。包含Myx的过去并延续第一款游戏的真实结局。

谁不想要朋友呢？（至少Myx是这样？）作为残疾鸟类天才和社会弃儿Myx，你将通过她的眼睛看到生活，并帮助她做出一些决定，如何饲养一台看似有感知力且栩栩如生的计算机。

…

但你已经知道会发生什么……？

[来自[url=https://mintglow.itch.io/myxs-bittersweet-musings]Itch.io[/url]]
